scenes.narration: You spend a dollar at Chipotle. Guess how much of it is the actual food?
Workers take about 25 cents. The restaurant keeps about 25 cents as restaurant-level profit.
Chipotle's sales hit 11.9 billion dollars in 2025, and it opened a record 334 company-owned restaurants.
The rest, about 20 cents, covers other costs like rent and supplies.
Food and workers take more than half of every dollar. Follow for more.
